newsitem.title: USA: Physician Support names Drinkwater COO.
newsitem.headline: Physician Support names Drinkwater COO.

text.p: Physician Support Systems Inc said Friday it named Michael Drinkwater president and chief operating officer of the company.

The company said Peter Gilson, whose previous title was president and chief executive officer, will continue as chief executive officer. Hamilton Potter III, previously executive vice president and chief operating officer, will serve as executive vice president of corporate development.
Drinkwater was most recently president of Medaphis Physicians Service Division, a division of Medaphis Corp.
